---
title: "Good habits, bad habits"
author: "Mohammad Tanviruzzaman"
date: "2026-10-09"
categories: [life]
---

> A habit is a learned association between a context cue and a response, built through repetition and reinforced by immediate reward. Minimizing environmental friction lowers the activation energy needed to repeat the action, locking the loop in place. Once established, the cue triggers the response automatically—persisting even without the reward, and running unseen until tracking restores conscious choice.
